About War Horse Roofing, LLC

Wade LeBeau.

Owner and founder

Wade founded War Horse Roofing in Fort Washakie, Wyoming, bringing decades of construction and roofing experience to the commercial buildings his company serves.

A member of the Shoshone Nation, Wade served in the U.S. Navy from 1994 to 1999. He continued his service in the Navy Reserve and Army Reserve. Helping fellow veterans build businesses of their own is part of why he started the company.

Contact Wade

Service area

Based in Fort Washakie. Working across Wyoming.

Wade handles project inquiries from across the state. For work farther from Fort Washakie, he also works with regional partners, including Joey Waller and his crew.
